documents.title: Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Analyst / Investor Meet - Outcome
Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Analyst / Investor Meet - Outcome
Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Press Release / Media Release

analysis.summary: Management reported a strong revenue of INR 235 crores in Q2 FY27, registering an 80% year-on-year growth, driven by robust demand in commercial vehicles and trailer segments. The company highlighted ongoing capacity expansions, backward integration initiatives such as the seamless tube facility, and commercial production of extruded axle beams. While rising consumable and commodity costs have put pressure on margins, price revisions concluded with OEMs and Tier 1 customers are expected to support performance in the upcoming quarters. Kross Limited reported strong financial and operational momentum for Q2 and H1 FY27, driven by robust OEM demand in the M&HCV segment and consistent demand in trailer and tractor segments. Revenue from operations reached ₹235.1 crore in Q2 FY27, marking a 79.6% year-on-year increase, with EBITDA at ₹30.6 crore and PAT at ₹19.7 crore.

guidance.claim: Management expects Q3 and Q4 volumes to be stronger than Q2 based on current indications.
guidance.quote: Based on our current indication, we expect Q3 and Q4 volumes to be stronger than Q2.

guidance.claim: Management expects the utilization of expanded capacities to improve over the coming quarters.
guidance.quote: The investments we have made in the capacity expansion and operational capabilities are beginning to support our growth, and we expect the utilization of these expanded capacities to improve over the coming quarters.

guidance.claim: Management expects export business for the year to be 45% higher than the previous year.
guidance.quote: Year-on-year, we expect this year to be 45% higher than our previous year.

guidance.claim: Management expects Q3 and Q4 volumes to be stronger than Q2, noting that historically H2 is always 10-15% up than H1.
guidance.quote: Q3 and Q4 volumes expected to be stronger than Q2 and historically also H2 is always 10-15% up than H1.

guidance.claim: Capacity utilisation is expected to improve in the coming quarters.
guidance.quote: Capacity expansion investments are beginning to support growth, with utilisation expected to improve in the coming quarters.

guidance.claim: Momentum in the tractor segment is expected to continue into Q3.
guidance.quote: Momentum expected to continue into Q3; contribution of this segment set to rise over the coming years.

guidance.claim: The company is targeting an export contribution of approximately 8% of its business in the next two years.
guidance.quote: We've mentioned this before is that the plan is to have at least 8% of exports coming in in the next two years' time.

guidance.claim: Management expects export growth of 40% to 45% for the financial year.
guidance.quote: We are looking into having a growth of 40%, 45% in our exports for this financial year.

demand_outlook.claim: Demand in the agricultural segment has remained consistent, with management expecting momentum to continue into Q3.
demand_outlook.quote: Demand in the Agri segment has remained consistent. We expect this momentum to continue into Q3, supported by relatively lower inventory levels of tractors in the market.

demand_outlook.claim: The momentum in the commercial segment has continued with robust demand indicated by OEMs.
demand_outlook.quote: The momentum in the commercial segment has continued with robust demand indicated by the OEMs.

demand_outlook.claim: Demand from commercial vehicles has been exceptionally good since GST rationalization.
demand_outlook.quote: Now we see that over the last 2, 3, 4 quarters since the time the GST rationalization has come in, demand from CV has been exceptionally good.

demand_outlook.claim: Momentum in the M&HCV segment continued with robust OEM demand.
demand_outlook.quote: M&HCV Segment: Momentum continued with robust OEM demand.

demand_outlook.claim: Trailer segment volumes in Q2 exceeded Q4 FY26 levels.
demand_outlook.quote: Trailer Segment: Q2 volumes exceeded Q4 FY26 levels.

demand_outlook.claim: Demand in the tractor and agri segment remained consistent, supported by relatively low inventory levels of tractors in the market.
demand_outlook.quote: Tractor & Agri Segment: Demand remained consistent, supported by relatively low inventory levels of tractors in the market.

demand_outlook.claim: The tractor segment is doing very well, and commercial vehicles along with the trailer segment are performing better than expected.
demand_outlook.quote: The trailer segment -- sorry, the tractor segment is doing very well and commercial vehicles along with the trailer segment is doing better than expected.

demand_outlook.claim: OEMs have indicated strong expectations for September Q2, Q3, and Q4, supported by healthy order books.
demand_outlook.quote: In spite of that, there has been indications from the OEMs for a strong September Q2 and then subsequently Q3 and Q4. These trends are first time supported by healthy order books.

demand_outlook.claim: The tractor industry data for April 2026 remained encouraging, and the company remains on track to meaningfully increase tractor segment sales contribution.
demand_outlook.quote: April 2026 tractor industry data remained encouraging and we remain on track to meaningfully increase the contribution of tractor segment sales to our revenues.

demand_outlook.claim: The CV business is projected to grow well in terms of volumes this year, backed by good projections from September onwards up to March.
demand_outlook.quote: So Mihir, the CV business is supposed to grow well in terms of volumes this year. We have been indicated very good projections from September onwards right up to March.

capex_expansion.claim: The company is undertaking a preferential issue to the tune of INR 63.6 crores.
capex_expansion.quote: The company is completely focused on capacity expansion and gearing up for the coming years, which is also witnessed by a preferential issue to the tune of INR63.6 crores.

capex_expansion.claim: Commercial production of extruded axle beams has commenced, with current capacity standing at 7,500 units per month.
capex_expansion.quote: Commercial production of extruded axle beams has commenced • Current axle beam capacity stands at 7,500 units per month

capex_expansion.claim: The seamless tube facility has mills installed, with production trials targeted for February-March 2027.
capex_expansion.quote: Seamless tube facility: mills installed, production trials targeted for February–March 2027.

capex_expansion.claim: The high-pressure moulding line in the foundry is progressing as planned to double existing casting capacity.
capex_expansion.quote: High-pressure moulding line (Foundry) Progressing as planned to double existing casting capacity.

capex_expansion.claim: The extrusion line has been successfully commissioned and productionized.
capex_expansion.quote: We have finally commissioned and productionized our extrusion line.

capex_expansion.claim: Progress on the seamless tube facility is on track, with the piercing mill received and other mills on the high seas.
capex_expansion.quote: Progress on the seamless tube facility is on track. Piercing mill has been received, sizing and straightening mills are on the high seas and this is progressing as per schedule.

capex_expansion.claim: A high-pressure mold line for the foundry is expected to start in Q3, doubling foundry capacity.
capex_expansion.quote: A high-pressure mold line for our foundry is expected to start in Q3. This will double our foundry capacity.

capex_expansion.claim: The axle shaft production facility using material gathering and press forging technology is on track for commissioning by September 2026.
capex_expansion.quote: Axle shaft production facility using material gathering and press forging technology is on track for commissioning by September 2026.

margins_costs.claim: During Q2 FY '27, EBITDA margins stood at 13%.
margins_costs.quote: EBITDA was INR 30.6 crores and EBITDA margins of 13%, while profit after tax stood at INR (197) million, reflecting to a year-on-year change of 143%.

margins_costs.claim: Price revisions concluded with OEMs and Tier 1 customers are expected to support the company during Q3 and Q4.
margins_costs.quote: While we have witnessed some pressures from rising consumable and commodity costs, the price revisions, including -- concluded with the OEMs and Tier 1 customers are expected to support us during the Q3 and Q4.

margins_costs.claim: Price revisions with most OEMs and Tier-1 customers were concluded, supporting profitability despite input-cost pressures.
margins_costs.quote: Price revisions with most OEMs and Tier-1 customers concluded, supporting profitability despite input-cost pressures.

margins_costs.claim: Q1 FY27 EBITDA grew by 39.5% year-on-year to 225.54 million with margin expansion to 12.23%.
margins_costs.quote: EBITDA grew by 39.5% year-on-year to 225.54 million with margin expansions to 12.23%, while PAT increased 24.4% year-on-year to 133.12 million.

margins_costs.claim: A recent steel price settlement retrospective to suppliers was given around July 15th at INR4,700 per kilo.
margins_costs.quote: One is with the commodity price increase, that is steel for us. So steel, there has been a very recent settlement which has been given retrospective to all the suppliers. This has just happened around the 15th of July where INR4,700 per kilo has been given.

margins_costs.claim: Quarter-on-quarter margin expansion is anticipated due to steel price compensation and conversion cost increases.
margins_costs.quote: The impact is not totally, but quarter-to-quarter we will be expanding on margins and this will not only be compensated by the steel price, but also by the conversion increase.

margins_costs.claim: Price increases of 3% to 5% were implemented in the trailer business effective April 1st.
margins_costs.quote: So, we have increased our prices on our trailer business with effect from 1st of April itself, right. We have already increased that and prices have to be in line with what competition is.

orders_capacity.claim: Q2 trailer volumes have exceeded the earlier record levels of Q4 of '26.
orders_capacity.quote: Our Q2 volumes have exceeded the earlier record levels of Q4 of '26.

orders_capacity.claim: Installed capacity for tipping jacks is 800 kits per month.
orders_capacity.quote: Installed capacity of 800 kits/month providing substantial headroom for future growth.

orders_capacity.claim: Volumes on axles and suspensions increased by 30% year-on-year.
orders_capacity.quote: The extruded axle beam has started production and volumes on axles and suspensions have increased 30% year-on-year.

orders_capacity.claim: The company sold 226 tipping jacks in Q1 of FY27.
orders_capacity.quote: We have sold 226 in Q1 of FY27 and we hope to further scale this in the subsequent quarters.

orders_capacity.claim: The capacity to manufacture tipping jacks is 800 numbers a month, with expected 65% to 70% utilization by quarter four.
orders_capacity.quote: So as far as the utilization of it, we have a capacity to manufacture 800 numbers a month. The lines have already been set for that and we expect by quarter four to be at around 65% to 70% of that capacity utilization.

orders_capacity.claim: Q1 axle volume was approximately 9,500 numbers and suspension volume was around 3,200 to 3,300 numbers.
orders_capacity.quote: Yes, the overall axle volume is almost at 9,500 numbers and the suspension volumes are at around 3,200, 3,300 numbers, both mechanical and air put together.

capital_allocation.claim: IPO funds have been fully utilized as per plan toward capacity expansion and working capital.
capital_allocation.quote: On our fund utilization from the IPO, we have utilized fully as per the plan. This has been achieved and the funds deployed towards capacity expansion and working capital have been as per plan.

capital_allocation.claim: Necessary term loan and debt have been taken for the seamless tube facility, with no immediate debt plans for the existing business.
capital_allocation.quote: For our existing business, there is no plan on any debt in the immediate timeline.

risks_headwinds.claim: Management noted pressures from rising consumable and commodity costs.
risks_headwinds.quote: While we have witnessed some pressures from rising consumable and commodity costs, the price revisions, including -- concluded with the OEMs and Tier 1 customers are expected to support us during the Q3 and Q4.

risks_headwinds.claim: The months of June and July experience slightly subdued demand due to monsoon.
risks_headwinds.quote: The period of June, July are where demands are slightly subdued due to monsoon.

management_commitments.claim: Management plans to undertake production trials for the seamless tube facility in February or March of 2027.
management_commitments.quote: The sizing mill and straightening mills have been received and installed, and we plan to undertake production trials in February or March of 2027.

management_commitments.claim: The company plans to achieve approximately 8% of exports contribution to revenue in the next two years.
management_commitments.quote: We've mentioned this before is that the plan is to have at least 8% of exports coming in in the next two years' time.

management_commitments.claim: The axle shaft production facility is on track for commissioning by September 2026.
management_commitments.quote: Axle shaft production facility using material gathering and press forging technology is on track for commissioning by September 2026.

management_commitments.claim: Production trials for the seamless tube plant are expected to take place by the end of this financial year.
management_commitments.quote: So, I think by end of this financial year, we should be doing some production trials.

_meta.note: Facts are verbatim-grounded against the company's own documents; claims whose quote was not found were dropped.
